events.title: NEST: A Multilingual Story
events.ageLabel: Best for ages 1 to 6, all ages welcome
events.schedule: Sat Nov 21 and Sun Nov 22, 9:30am and 11:30am (40 min)
events.priceLabel: $18.50 plus $3 fee, members $14.50, $3 with Card to Culture

registration.note: Tickets are on sale on the event page. One price covers every age. Card to Culture holders (WIC, EBT, MassHealth, ConnectorCare) pay $3.

events.description: A baby bird and a forest fairy explore the seasons with hand puppets and live classical guitar. Simple words come in English, French, Spanish and Russian.
events.sourceNote: Dates, times, 40-min run time, ages 1-6, prices ($18.50 general admission plus $3 service fee, $14.50 members, $3 Card to Culture), venue and 30-min post-show meet-the-puppets activity confirmed on the puppetshowplace.org NEST event page and the theater's November 2026 calendar. Page does not show sold-out status.

events.title: Holiday Pops Kids' Matinee
events.ageLabel: Made for young kids, under 2 free by phone
events.schedule: Select days Dec 6 to Dec 24, 11am (about 1 hour)
events.priceLabel: Under 2 free by phone. See the official page for prices

registration.note: Buy tickets online for each date. For a free ticket for a child under 2, call 617-266-1200 when buying adult tickets. Phone hours are weekdays 10am to 4pm and Saturdays 12:30pm to 4:30pm.

events.description: A shorter Holiday Pops concert with no intermission, made for younger listeners. Families can meet Santa and enjoy treats after the show.
events.sourceNote: Seven 11:00 AM dates (Dec 6, 12, 13, 19, 20, 23, 24), Symphony Hall, approx. one-hour run time with no intermission, free under-2 tickets by calling 617-266-1200, phone hours and meet-Santa note confirmed on bso.org/events/kids-matinee-2026. Prices and a formal age range are not stated. Dec 6 shows a Buy Tickets link. Other dates show a 'Tickets will be available on' line with the date left blank, so their on-sale date is unknown.

events.title: Babytime
events.ageLabel: Babies who are not walking yet

registration.note: No registration or ticket needed. Head to Hunneman Hall at the Brookline Village Library.

events.description: A baby lapsit with songs and play. Grown-ups sit on the floor with babies on their laps. The second half is open play and time to meet other families.
events.sourceNote: Monday 10:30-11:15 AM sessions (Nov 9, 16, 30, Dec 7, 14), location, 'no registration required', format and the not-yet-walking rule confirmed on the Brookline Library LibCal Babytime page (Nov 2 session) and its listed series dates. No Nov 23 date is listed. The library gives no age in months, so ageMaxMonths 12 approximates babies not yet walking.

registration.note: Free tickets go out first come, first served on the day. The whole party must be there to get one. Room for 15 babies. The program starts on time.

events.description: Bounces and rhymes for babies and their grown-ups. Each session helps little ones build language and motor skills.
events.sourceNote: Nov 25, 2026 10:00-10:30 AM session, Rey Room location, ages 0-18 months, same-day first-come tickets and 15-baby cap confirmed on the cambridgema.gov event page. A Nov 4 session (also Wednesday) and earlier Wednesday pages (Aug 5, Aug 12, Sep 2, Sep 16) show the Wednesday pattern, but the city calendar is script-driven and Nov 11 and Nov 18 pages could not be loaded, so only Nov 25 is listed as a session.

events.priceLabel: See the official page for prices

registration.note: Buy through the Tickets & Show Times link or BosTix. The Dec 6 2pm and Dec 11 7:30pm shows are access performances. Every show has open captions.

events.description: A bright stage version of the Pixar film. Marlin, a cautious clownfish dad, leaves the reef to find his son Nemo.
events.sourceNote: Run Nov 14-Dec 13, 2026, about 75 min with intermission, ages 4 and up, venue, ticket channels (OvationTix, BosTix), open captions at every show and access performances (Dec 6 2 PM, Dec 11 7:30 PM, plus a Dec 9 10:30 AM student matinee left out here) confirmed on wheelockfamilytheatre.org. events.priceLabel: $24 adults and kids 1 to 15, under 12 months free

events.description: A hands-on children's museum on the Fort Point Channel. Babies under 12 months get in free.
events.sourceNote: Hours (Wed-Mon 9 AM-4 PM, closed Tue, 10 AM opening on the first Saturday of each month), admission ($24 adults and children 1-15, under 12 months free, members free) and the advance-ticket recommendation confirmed on bostonchildrensmuseum.org calendar and event pages.
